theme: Last day ashore before a week at sea.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Today Dubrovnik's old town gives way to the water — a final run of dry-land errands, then you board the charter around five.

needsAttention.title: Lock in the Sept 19 Cavtat arrivals day
needsAttention.detail: The hotel is booked, but the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, an afternoon bag hold, and a ~5:15 AM checkout for your flight all need arranging from dry land. Charter connectivity is poor to none once you board at five.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with Nautilus
needsAttention.detail: Amy from Nautilus wrote to wish you a good trip; still nail down the exact meeting time and place for this afternoon's boarding, and pre-arrange the Sept 19 return transfer to the airport while you can.

needsAttention.title: Provision in Dubrovnik
needsAttention.detail: Cash (~200 EUR), snacks, wine, and any gluten-free items are far easier bought ashore than aboard. Studenac, Tommy, or Konzum, and fit it in before the 5 PM boarding.

schedule.title: Board the Nautilus charter
schedule.detail: Dubrovnik / Komolac, local time — a week of sailing begins

flagged.title: New governance and affairs roles from LinkedIn
flagged.detail: Fresh alerts for a VP, Government Affairs opening and a Sr. Government Relations Manager posting — worth a scan when you're next online.

flagged.title: Mattress Firm / Synchrony statement ready
flagged.detail: The monthly statement on the account ending 5129 is available to view. A glance, no action.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters (FT, NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, your Italian and Japanese drills), receipts, and automated notices.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: Carol Hansell parked until you're back
resolved.detail: Your reconnect thread closed itself — you offered to talk after the 19th and she wrote back, 'Happy sailing! Let's talk when you are back.'

recipe.title: Duck breasts with apples & caraway
recipe.why: The first crisp edge of autumn calls for duck and apples — a slow, technique-forward supper for a quiet Maine weekend.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 20-Oct 5 rental car (full-size SUV, TPA)
Book the St Pete Sept 20-21 gap and confirm the Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb converted

acts.line: Your last morning ashore in Dubrovnik — errands are far easier now than they'll be once you're underway.
Everything for the Sept 19 return — the Cavtat transfer, bag hold, dawn checkout — wants sorting before you cast off.
By tonight you're aboard and largely offline; the boat sets the pace from here.
